title: health-monitor
summary: Configurable health checks for adapters and integrations, on a schedule

methods.name: listTargets
methods.summary: Best-effort list of installed adapter/integration/app instances
methods.description: Read from the service_configs collection as a convenience for populating the Add Check form - see src.js for caveats

methods.name: getIntegrationOperations
methods.summary: List the operations an Integration's own OpenAPI model defines
methods.description: Looks up the target's model via service_configs.properties.type -> integration_models.versionId and returns its operations, plus any operation marked x-health-monitor-default (set from the OpenAPI Editor's Operations tab), for the Add/Edit Check form's operation picker. Not meaningful for adapters/apps in this version - returns an empty list rather than an error for those.

methods.name: listChecks
methods.summary: List all configured health checks with their latest status

methods.name: getCheck
methods.summary: Get a single health check config + status by id

methods.name: createCheck
methods.summary: Create a new health check configuration

methods.name: updateCheck
methods.summary: Update an existing health check configuration

methods.name: runCheckNow
methods.summary: Immediately execute one health check out of band and record its result

methods.name: restartTarget
methods.summary: Restart the adapter or app a check targets (stop then start)
methods.description: Calls Itential Platform's own PUT /adapters/{name}/stop + /start (or /applications/{name}/... for Apps) for the check's configured target. Not offered for Integration targets - restarting a process is not a concept that applies to them.

output.name: result
output.description: { success: boolean, status: string, message: string }

methods.name: encryptValue
methods.summary: Encrypt a plaintext value using IAP's own PropertyEncryption module
methods.description: Admin utility: returns the $ENC...-encrypted form of a plaintext value, the same encryption this app now applies automatically to a check's authPassword/authToken/oauth.clientSecret before storing it. Useful for producing an $ENC... string to paste into this (or any other app's) Service Instance properties by hand, e.g. mongoProps.password or platformProps.oauth.clientSecret, instead of leaving them as plaintext. Does not persist anything.
